common_cta_section_title_2: Sami Wallet ɗin Bitcoin na Farko
common_what_is_bitcoin_content_1: Bitcoin abubuwa biyu ne: kuɗi na dijital da cibiyar sadarwa ta biyan kuɗi. Za ka iya aika Bitcoin (kuɗi na dijital) kai tsaye ga wasu mutane ta amfani da cibiyar sadarwar Bitcoin (cibiyar sadarwa ta biyan kuɗi).
common_what_is_bitcoin_content_2: Bitcoin sabuwar hanya ce ta adana da canja wurin daraja. Ba kamar cibiyoyin sadarwar kuɗi na yau da kullum ba, cibiyar sadarwar Bitcoin tana iya aiki ba tare da hukumomin tsakiya ko masu gudanarwa na aminci ba. Wannan yana sa Bitcoin ya zama kuɗi na farko buɗaɗɗen da ba shi da iyakoki.
common_what_is_bitcoin_content_3: Bitcoin kuɗi ne na dijital da ke ba ka cikakken mallakar dukiyarka. A karon farko a tarihin ɗan adam kowa na iya mallakar kadara da ta yi ƙarancin gaske, ba ta buƙatar izini don amfani, kuma ba za a iya kwace ta ba idan aka ajiye ta daidai.
common_what_is_bitcoin_content_4: Za a iya aika Bitcoin ko'ina a duniya, cikin sauri da arha. Ba ya buƙatar mai tura na uku, kamar banki.
common_what_is_bitcoin_content_5: Bitcoin yana ba kowa damar adana dukiyarsu cikin aminci ba tare da damuwa da gwamnati ta sace ta ko rage darajarta ta hanyar buga kuɗi ba.
common_what_is_bitcoin_content_6: Gwamnatoci ko'ina za su iya buga ƙarin takardun kuɗi, amma babu wanda zai iya buga ƙarin bitcoin.
common_what_is_bitcoin_content_7: Za ka iya kula da Bitcoin ɗinka da kanka cikin sauƙi don samun cikakken iko, wanda ke ba ka cikakken damar amfani da ikon Bitcoin.
common_what_is_bitcoin_content_8: Idan za ka iya zazzage manhaja, za ka iya kula da Bitcoin da kanka kuma ka adana dukiyarka ba tare da dogaro da kowa ba.
common_bitcoin_volatile: NA JI BITCOIN YANA DA GIRGIZA. AMINTACCE NE?
common_bitcoin_volatile_content_1: A ɗan gajeren lokaci, farashin musayar Bitcoin yana canzawa. Ana kiran wannan girgiza.
common_bitcoin_volatile_content_2: Amma girgizar da kake gani a kullum tana 'ɓacewa' a dogon lokaci.
common_bitcoin_volatile_content_3: Bitcoin yana ci gaba da rage girgiza da lokaci. Yayin da ƙarin mutane ke amfani da Bitcoin a matsayin asusun ajiya na dogon lokaci, darajarsa tana ƙara daidaituwa.
common_bitcoin_volatile_content_4: Mutane da yawa sun zaɓi adana daraja a Bitcoin tsawon shekaru da yawa a matsayin hanya mai aminci ta rage haɗarin girgiza da kare ikon siyen su da lokaci.
common_bitcoin_volatile_content_5: A wasu ƙasashe, kamar Venezuela, Sudan, Lebanon, Syria, Argentina, Turkey, Brazil, da ƙasashe da yawa, darajar kuɗin gida tana raguwa da sauri sosai har Bitcoin ya zama hanyar adana kuɗi mafi daidaituwa.
common_bitcoin_afford: BA ZAN IYA SIYAN CIKAKKEN BITCOIN BA
common_bitcoin_afford_content_1: Dala tana da senti 100. Bitcoin yana da sats 100,000,000 (miliyan 100).
common_bitcoin_afford_content_2: Ba sai ka mallaki cikakken bitcoin ba. Yawancin mutane suna mallakar sats kawai. Sats ɓangarorin bitcoin ne. Misali, idan cikakken bitcoin 1 ya kai $100,000 to $1 za ta sayo maka sats 1,000!
common_bitcoin_hacked_content_1: Wataƙila ka ji game da 'satar Bitcoin' ta yanar gizo ko a cikin labarai. Yawancin mutane suna karanta waɗannan labaran suna ganin an saci cibiyar sadarwar Bitcoin. Amma ba a taɓa saci cibiyar sadarwar Bitcoin ba.
common_bitcoin_hacked_content_2: Menene cibiyar sadarwar Bitcoin? To, ka yi tunanin cibiyar sadarwar Bitcoin a matsayin hanyoyin jirgin ƙasa. Jiragen ƙasa da ke tafiya a kan hanyoyin jirgin ƙasa na cibiyar sadarwar Bitcoin su ne ma'amalolin Bitcoin.
common_bitcoin_hacked_content_3: Idan ka karanta game da satar Bitcoin a cikin labarai, kana karanta ne game da mai ajiya (kamar FTX) da aka sace ko ya yi fatara.
common_bitcoin_hacked_content_4: Masu ajiya kamfanoni ne da ke riƙe bitcoin ɗinka a madadin ka. Amma wannan yana ɗauke da haɗari: rasa bitcoin ɗinka idan kamfanin ya yi rashin gudanarwa, ya sace shi, ko ya yi fatara.
common_bitcoin_hacked_content_5: Wannan ya faru kwanan nan da FTX.
common_bitcoin_hacked_content_6: Kowa da ya amince da FTX da bitcoin ɗin su ya rasa bitcoin ɗin su. Kowa da ya ajiye bitcoin ɗin su a kula da kansu bai shafi abin da FTX ta yi ba kwata-kwata. Wannan shine ikon bitcoin a kula da kanka: cikakken iko na gaske a kan kuɗinka.
common_bitcoin_hacked_content_7: Maimakon barin bitcoin ɗinka a musayar ko a cikin rufe kamar ETF, ka ajiye shi a wallet ɗinka don duk fa'idodin 'yanci.
common_bitcoin_hacked_content_8: Idan kana kula da bitcoin ɗinka da kanka, kuɗinka yana kariya ta cibiyar sadarwar Bitcoin. Ita ce cibiyar sadarwar kuɗi mafi aminci a duniya.
common_bitcoin_hacked_content_9: A kula da kanka, Sam daga FTX ba zai iya satar bitcoin ɗinka ba.
common_bitcoin_hacked_content_10: Gwamnati ba za ta iya buga ƙarin bitcoin ta haifar da hauhawar farashi ba.
common_bitcoin_hacked_content_11: Bitcoin a kula da kanka kuɗinka ne, godiya ga ikon cibiyar sadarwar Bitcoin.
common_bitcoin_energy: ME YA SA BITCOIN KE AMFANI DA WUTAR LANTARKI?
common_bitcoin_energy_content_1: Bitcoin yana amfani da wutar lantarki don kare cibiyar sadarwar da kare kuɗinka.
common_bitcoin_energy_content_2: Bitcoin yana amfani da adadin wutar lantarki mai yawa, kuma wannan abu ne mai kyau saboda dalilai da yawa.
common_bitcoin_energy_list_1: Bitcoin ba shi da guguwar bankuna.
common_bitcoin_energy_list_2: Bitcoin yana taimakawa wajen daidaita tsarin wutar lantarki ta hanyar haƙo bitcoin.
common_bitcoin_energy_list_3: Bitcoin yana rage fitar da iskar gas daga haƙon mai.
common_bitcoin_energy_list_4: Bitcoin yana amfani da ƙarancin wutar lantarki fiye da yadda Amurkawa ke amfani da su don fitilun Kirsimeti kowace shekara.
common_bitcoin_energy_list_5: Bitcoin shine masana'anta mafi kore a duniya!
common_cic_intro_1: Mutane da yawa sun san game da Ribar Tara, amma kaɗan ne suka san game da Hauhawar Farashi ta Tara.
common_cic_intro_2: Da Na'urar Lissafin Hauhawar Farashi ta Tara, za ku iya lissafin adadin da albashinku ke buƙatar ƙaruwa don kula da ikon siyen ku da lokaci cikin sauƙi.
common_cic_intro_3: Kawai shigar da albashinku na yanzu, yawan hauhawar farashi, da adadin shekarun da kuke son lissafa, kuma na'urar lissafin mu za ta nuna muku abin da albashinku ke buƙatar kasancewa don ci gaba da hauhawar farashi.
